method: Mined Xiaohongshu directly rather than a scout feed: four search terms (市面上还缺 / 求一个能的app / 为什么没人做这个app / 每次都要自己), four high-engagement notes opened, comment trees extracted verbatim. Three independent commenters in one thread converge on the same missing product, and one names the blocker. Cross-checked against the operator's own starred radar entries #1+102 and #533, which sit on the same 体检报告 line.
gap: It hits a real pain and every existing product solves the wrong half. 薄荷 / Cal AI / Caloris are calorie diaries — you log what you already ate. Nobody reads the packet before you buy it, and nobody connects either end to the check-up report. Commenters name the blocker themselves: they assume you need hospital data access, which is exactly the assumption that keeps the aisle-side version — which needs none — unbuilt.

zh.gap: 痛点击中了，而现有产品全都在解另一半。薄荷 / Cal AI / Caloris 是卡路里日记——你记的是已经吃下去的。没人在你掏钱之前读那张包装背面，也没人把任何一头接到体检报告上。评论区自己说出了拦路虎：他们默认这事要接医院数据——而正是这个默认，让根本不需要医院数据的「货架那一侧」至今空着。

zh.pain: 一个人拿着体检报告走出医院，上面飘红三项；等他站在超市货架前手里捏着两包东西时，那份报告对他毫无用处。
zh.kill: 这是贴着健康的东西，诚实的天花板就很低：你只能翻译和比对，不能建议；一旦它说出「这个别吃」，那就是行医。国内平台也在边上转——某家体检连锁或保险公司可以直接打包送，薄荷加一个配料表识别也就是一个版本的事。更深的风险在行为上：会看配料表的人本来就在看，不看的人不会因为一个 App 就开始看。
zh.move: 拒绝评论区所有人都默认必须有的那个「接医院」幻想。用户上传自己手里已经有的那份报告（PDF 或拍照），把飘红的三到五项变成三到五条买东西时的规则；此后产品只干一件事：拍配料表，出一句对照这几条规则的判断，外加同一层货架上的一个替代品。不做食谱、不做诊断、不做饮食记录，每一句判断后面都跟一句「该去问医生/营养师什么」。冷启动（中文）：这条笔记的评论树，以及小红书「配料表 怎么看」「体检报告 解读」——人们已经在那里贴包装照片问陌生人了；冷启动（英文）：r/nutrition 与 r/loseit 搜 which one should I buy、read my bloodwork。

pain: Someone walks out of a check-up with three numbers flagged red, and by the time they are standing in the supermarket aisle holding two packets, the report is useless to them.
kill: This is health-adjacent, so the honest ceiling is low: you can translate and compare, you cannot advise, and the moment it says 'do not eat this' it is practising medicine. Chinese platforms are also circling — a big check-up chain or an insurer can bundle it, and 薄荷 can add label OCR in one release. The deeper risk is behavioural: people who read labels already read labels, and people who do not will not start because an app asked them to.
move: Refuse the hospital-integration fantasy that everyone in that comment thread assumes is required. The user uploads the PDF or photo of the report they already hold, three to five flagged lines get turned into three to five plain-language shopping rules, and from then on the product does exactly one thing: photograph a nutrition label, get a one-line verdict against those rules plus one alternative on the same shelf. No diet plan, no diagnosis, no meal logging, and every verdict ends with what to ask a doctor or dietitian. Cold start (Chinese): the comment tree of this note and 「配料表 怎么看」 / 「体检报告 解读」 on Xiaohongshu, where people are already posting label photos and asking strangers; Cold start (English): r/nutrition and r/loseit, search 'which one should I buy' and 'read my bloodwork'.
